_about: cc-P107 (Haven H2 and H3): where the ops pages (Play tests, Ideas, Bug reports, Shard status) live. Read by the Shard Console, Publish-GamePcSnapshot.ps1, the commit script's mirror refresh (shard-migration tools/opsmirror.py) and docker/ops/Deploy-HavenOps.ps1. Which side is serving right now is NOT here: it is the mode in stateFile, written by the cutover and the rollback, so this file never changes at a cutover. No token, key or password ever goes in this file.

haven._root: The stack, its data and the clones live under chase's home on Haven, so nothing needs sudo. P89 proposed /srv/sl-ops; this is the same layout one place over.

gamePc._gamePc: Today's service, and the fallback: the rollback starts it again.

_files: Both outside both repos. state.json is {mode: local|haven, since, by}. token.txt is the bearer token of Haven's token listener (export, ingest); the deploy writes it once, from a prompt, and never prints it.

repos._repos: shard-migration is private (an anonymous git ls-remote is refused, 2026-10-14), so Haven reads it over SSH with a read-only deploy key the deploy makes on Haven; the infrastructure repo is public and read anonymously.
